notes: IMPORTANT CONTEXT: this session began by reading the local working-branch checkout, which still showed an empty database, and proceeded as if this were the first-ever research session. While this session's research was in progress, a separate concurrent session independently ran its own first-baseline research, recorded it as SEARCH-0001 (GHL-0001–GHL-0006, COMP-0001–COMP-0006), added a data-driven dashboard (docs/index.html + docs/data/*.json mirrors), and merged it into main via PR #1 and #2 before this session's branch was merged. During PR reconciliation (2026-09-20), this session's 6 candidate leads were compared against the now-current main database: (1) Huzzle.com / GoHighLevel Marketing Automation Specialist (za.linkedin.com listing) was an exact duplicate by source_url — both sessions independently found the identical LinkedIn posting; kept as main's GHL-0006 and reconfirmed/re-timestamped rather than duplicated. (2) Exquisite Hair Junkies LLC / 'CRM & Marketing Automation Specialist' (Indeed) was originally logged here as a POTENTIAL lead based only on a search snippet and a flagged suspicion that its stated 7–9-year experience requirement seemed mismatched for a small salon. The other session had independently pulled the full job description via Indeed's job-details API and found it actually requires Salesforce, SQL, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and Google Analytics with the CRM platform named as 'Tax Nitro' — no GoHighLevel mention anywhere. This session re-verified that finding directly via the Indeed job-details tool during reconciliation and confirmed it: the posting does not match the user's actual skill profile and does not belong in this database. It has been dropped entirely (not carried over even as POTENTIAL), and this note is left as a record of why, per the 'never invent/assume fit' rule — this is a useful lesson that a full job-details fetch should be preferred over a search-snippet title match whenever the tool is available, especially for roles surfaced through generic keyword search rather than a GHL-specific query. (3) The remaining 4 candidates (BruntWork, Jobgether, EverestX, and one anonymous Upwork GHL Implementation Specialist contract-to-hire project) were genuinely new and were appended as GHL-0007–GHL-0010 with matching COMP-0007–COMP-0009 company records, continuing main's existing ID sequence rather than restarting at GHL-0001/COMP-0001/SEARCH-0001 as originally recorded before reconciliation. docs/data/*.json were updated to mirror the reconciled database/*.json exactly, per the existing (manual, no build script) mirroring convention already established on main. Original session notes follow, describing the research as it was originally conducted (numbering below refers to the pre-reconciliation IDs and has since changed as described above). First research session; database, company list, and search history were all empty prior to this run. Direct WebFetch access to linkedin.com, www.upwork.com, to.indeed.com (Indeed's own redirect domain), www.ziprecruiter.com, and www.glassdoor.com is blocked by this environment's network egress proxy, so verification for those sources relied on web-search-engine indexing/snippets rather than live page fetches — flagged explicitly in every affected lead's notes and should be re-verified by the user directly before applying. The Indeed job-search tool itself worked and returned live results, but ~14 of 15 were irrelevant general marketing/ops/sales roles; only 1 (Exquisite Hair Junkies, GHL-0004) was CRM/automation-relevant. Excluded from the database as stale/likely expired: 6 Upwork fixed-price gigs found via search with posting ages from 7 weeks to 6+ months old (Viber/WhatsApp follow-up $100, cleaning-business setup $100, phone system/round-robin $200, Eventbrite webhook $50, WhatsApp AI bot $400) — Upwork fixed-price gigs typically close within days, so presenting these as current would violate the freshness rule. Also excluded: two Nigeria-restricted LinkedIn listings (Ferah Assist, Funnel Hike) with unclear remote eligibility, an unpaid volunteer GHL funnel-building post (Inclusive Inc.), a BruntWork GoHighLevel Sales Representative role in South Asia (skill mismatch — sales, not automation/specialist work), a Mill Creek Marketing Media Buyer/Paid Ads role (skill mismatch — paid media buying isn't in the user's profile, GHL only mentioned as 'valuable'), and a Radco 'Business Systems Specialist' role that could not be confirmed as CRM/automation-related after a follow-up search. Noted but not added as leads (no hiring evidence, just vendor/competitor presence): GHL Prime, E2M Solutions, Fusemate, GHL Engine, Certified GoHighLevel Developers, Extendly — worth periodic monitoring for subcontractor openings in future sessions. Gaps for next session: Facebook groups, PeoplePerHour, Freelancer.com, Wellfound, Fiverr buyer requests, and non-US/UK markets (Canada, Australia, Middle East, EU) were not yet covered; also worth trying more targeted subreddit search (e.g. r/gohighlevel, r/agency, r/smallbusiness) since general reddit search returned no genuine threads this session.
